verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only standard client-credentials authentication: a client ID and secret are exchanged for an access token, and the same token authorizes the MCP server. Nothing documents issuing scoped, permission-restricted or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The MCP `--tools=` flag limits which tools are exposed, not what the credential itself can do, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
